'''Machook''' was a dark-furred Ewok present on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Machook was involved in the brief conflict between the Ewoks and their fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] allies, the [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbees]], which developed at the instigation of the [[Hiromi]] known as [[Hirog]].<ref name="MC 94">[[Star Wars (1977) 94|''Star Wars'' (1977) 94]]</ref><ref name="Hasbro" />

Machook shared the name with a [[Machook (legend)|hero]] in Ewok legends, said to have built the first tree village on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Machook first received a [[Hasbro]] action figure in 2008, as part of an Ewok three-pack including [[Kettch]] and [[Keoulkeech]], the packaging of which indicates an Ewok named Machook participated in the conflict with the [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbees]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> as seen in [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars (1977) 94|''Star Wars'' 94]]. He was not identified as any particular character seen in that comic book.<ref name="MC 94">[[Star Wars (1977) 94|''Star Wars'' (1977) 94]]</ref>

The ''San Diego Comic Con (SDCC) 2008: Hasbro Star Wars presentation'' announcing future figures to be released initially identified Machook as the tan-colored Ewok wearing a purple hood; however, Machook was later released as the dark-furred Ewok wearing a red hood, initially identified as Keoulkeech.<ref name="SDCC2008a">{{Rebelscum|url=SDCC08/Hasbro/presentation/default.asp|text=San Diago Comic Con (SDCC) 2008: Hasbro Star Wars presentation}}</ref>
